'''U-3PO''' was a [[3PO-series protocol droid]] who served the [[Alderaanian Diplomatic Corps]]. After [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] agents altered his programming, the [[droid]] became an unwitting [[spy]] in the [[House of Organa|royal court]] of the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]], and was assigned to the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'' in [[1 BBY]]. After the [[corvette]] fled from the [[Battle of Scarif]] carrying the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]], the Empire used U-3PO to track the vessel to the [[Tatoo system]].

The [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]'' then [[Secret mission to Tatooine|attacked]] the ''Tantive IV'', and the [[Star Destroyer]] fired upon the corvette, U-3PO followed the droids [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]] through the ''Tantive IV's'' main corridor before splitting off from them down a separate corridor. After the Empire captured the ''Tantive IV'' they discovered that U-3PO could provide no further useful information and that the [[Death Star]] plans were no longer aboard.

==Biography==
===Sleeper agent===
[[File:TantiveIVFinal.png|thumb|right|300px|U-3PO was assigned to the ''Tantive IV'' after being reprogrammed by Imperial agents.]]
U-3PO was a [[3PO-series protocol droid]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> that was manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica]]<ref name="Maker" /> and served in the [[Alderaanian Diplomatic Corps|Diplomatic Corps]] of the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]]. Agents of the [[Galactic Empire]] at some stage altered the [[droid]]'s programming and turned him into an unwitting Imperial spy within Alderaan's [[House of Organa|royal court]]. Luckily for the Empire, U-3PO was assigned to the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'' just before the vessel was assigned a [[Secret mission to Tatooine|mission]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in [[1 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of the [[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]], during which the ''[[Tantive IV]]'' is assigned to take [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to [[Tatooine]], to [[1 BBY]].</ref> to travel to the planet [[Tatooine]] and recruit the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="RO">[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]]</ref>

However, before the vessel was ready to depart for the mission from the rebel [[Great Temple|headquarters]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]], the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] was scrambled to the [[Scarif system]] in order to support [[Rogue One|Alliance forces]] attempting to steal the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. While under repairs, the ''Tantive IV'' was carried to the Scarif [[Star system|system]] on board the [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Profundity]]'',<ref name="Raymus">{{StoryCite|story=Raymus|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> which led the [[Battle of Scarif|attack]] on the planet [[Scarif]]'s [[Imperial Navy|Imperial forces]]. The plans were transmitted from the planet's surface to the ''Profundity'' mid-battle, but before it could retreat, the [[cruiser]] was disabled by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="RO" /> ''[[Devastator]]''.<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> As Imperial forces led by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] boarded the ''Profundity'', the plans were transferred onto the ''Tantive IV'' which then launched from the cruiser and fled from the Scarif system.<ref name="RO" />

===Capture of the ''Tantive IV''===
[[File:3POsAndR2-ANH.png|thumb|left|300px|U-3PO walked with C-3PO and R2-D2 as the ''Tantive IV'' was attacked.]]
The ''Tantive IV'' traveled to the [[Tatoo system]], the target of its original mission; however, U-3PO's altered programming caused him to send a signal that,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> alongside a faulty [[hyperdrive]] subsystem on the corvette,<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> allowed the ''Devastator'' to track the fleeing rebel ship and follow them with the aim of reclaiming the stolen plans. As the ''Tantive IV'' tried to get as close to Tatooine as possible, the [[Star Destroyer]] opened fire on it. During the attack, Organa summoned the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] to her, and U-3PO and the protocol droid [[C-3PO]] followed the astromech down the main corridor of the ship<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> as the corvette shuddered from the ''Devastator''{{'s}} strikes.<ref name="ANH" />

Both protocol droids struggled to keep their footing as the corridor shook,<ref name="ANH AD">{{Film|IV}} {{C|[[Disney+]] audio description}}</ref> and U-3PO walked down a side corridor<ref name="ANH" /> while the other droids carried on and left him to his duties. The Empire successfully captured the vessel and Organa, but discovered that U-3PO had no useful information to deliver and that the plans were no longer on board, as Organa had given them to R2-D2 before the astromech escaped from the Empire in an [[escape pod]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Characteristics==
U-3PO had [[Color|silver]] plating and yellow [[sensor]]s.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Answer the question: are you a Sith Lord, yes or no?|U-3PO questions [[Darth Sidious]] in the non-canon ''LEGO Star Wars: Choose Your Path''|<ref name="LEGOPath">''[[LEGO Star Wars: Choose Your Path]]''</ref>}}
U-3PO first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The character's scene was shot on Stage 9 at [[Elstree Studios]]<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> on [[July 13]], [[1976]].<ref name="Visual Guide">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp03.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide — Chapter 3: Imperial Boarding Party}}</ref> It was one of the final scenes shot for the film despite being one of the first shown.<ref name="MakingOf" /> Along with R2-D2 and C-3PO, U-3PO is one of the first characters shown on screen in any ''[[Star Wars]]'' film.<ref name="ANH" /> In the new ''Star Wars'' [[canon]], he was first identified in the non-canon [[2017]] reference book ''[[Ultimate LEGO Star Wars]]''.<ref name="LEGO" /> The name was then used in the canonical "[[The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin]]," a book published as part of the [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] series by [[De Agostini]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> on [[March 9]], [[2021]].<ref name="De Agostini">{{DeAgostini|lang=es|url=libros-comics/enciclopedia-star-wars|text=Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card in the [[1995]] ''[[A New Hope Limited]]'' set of the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=U-3PO}}</ref>

[[File:U-3PO-LEGO.png|thumb|right|300px|U-3PO appeared in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga''.]]
The non-canon [[2018]] choose-your-own-adventure book ''[[LEGO Star Wars: Choose Your Path]]'' by [[Simon Hugo]] included a mini-figure of U-3PO and had him act as a guide for the reader through the story, although it provides a warning that not all of his advice is helpful.<ref name="LEGOPath" /> U-3PO was one of the characters featured in the [[2021]] non-canon browser game [[LEGO Kids Memory Game|''LEGO Star Wars: Find the pairs'']] released on LEGO.com.<ref name="LEGOPAIRS">{{LEGOWeb|url=en-us/kids/star-wars/find-the-pairs|text=Find the pairs|nolive=1}}</ref> In the [[2022]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', U-3PO is shown walking beside a green astromech droid through the corridors of the ''Tantive IV'' before the pair are crushed by falling debris. C-3PO and R2-D2 then emerge from a side door and take the pair's place in walking down the corridor.<ref name="SkywalkerSaga">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>
